page.overview:
Who is Agent Faces?

Agent Faces is the G.I — part of G.I. Joe.

Joe team's answer to Zartan. He is a skilled mimic and is a proficient infiltrator. Agent Faces was featured prominently in Spy Troops: The Movie, but has not made any other animated appearances.

To date, Agent Faces has received two 3 3/4"action figures and one 12" figure. The first 3 3/4" figure, released in 2003, included two guns, a black bag with detachable strap, and two masks: Dr. Mindbender and Crimson Guard Commander.

This figure was packaged with Spy Troops Zartan.
